title: Temporary-register loop
statement: Let $C,d,x_0,a,b,t,e,p$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be any finite binary input. For every output string $o$, there is a run of at most $3t+1$ steps of the program determined by $C$ and $d$ that starts at the temporary-register test label with register values $(x_0,a,b,t,e)$, input position $p$, and output $o$, and ends at the main-loop label with register values $(x_0+t,a,b,0,e)$, the same input position $p$, and output $o$.
hypotheses_covered: An arbitrary output string, as quantified by the run relation
